title: Normal Ledyba lands at its own POOL site on permitted loaded terrain

verification.actor: One naturally spawned WILD Ledyba (165), bound by the actual finalized personality, source identity, current native object, and full generation-safe actor handle.
verification.trigger: From unchanged test.sav at Cherrygrove map67 (564,392), use44 exact normal player tiles: Right1 to (565,392), Down5 to (565,397), Left4 to (561,397), Up2 to (561,395), Left11 to (550,395), Up19 to Route30 (550,376), Right2 to (552,376). Stop new input on natural Ledyba acquisition and finish only the current admitted tile. No teleport, party, profile, RNG or save writes. Observe that same actor's own native144-frame Fly In.
verification.observable: Requirements shared.ledyba-pool-site-v1 and shared.ledyba-pool-surface-v1: preserve the actual current Fly In WILD Ledyba's own finalized legacy POOL site through its complete 144-frame flight. The native field-object creation call must create its visible sprite at the off-screen origin, never the landing target. Bind the first coherent elapsed-zero or elapsed-one flight sample to that constructor and the exact native START. At the exact admission and logical terminal target require current loaded metatile permission and exclusion of authored surfaces. The actual finalized targetBaseY must match physical terminal Y with zero shared height offset. Require the ordered full-identity logical commit, finish and control return. Missing data is unknown, not legal. This does not prove universal unmodeled geometry, later movement or chain actions.

setupMutations.change: Copy test.nds and unchanged test.sav into a private shared-tool session. Source bytes remain unchanged. The fixture seed is provenance, not a game RNG override.

Use the same91 setup actions as observation.ledyba-live-controls: require unchanged map67 at (564,392) and zero admitted player steps, then take at most44 normal cardinal tiles via (565,392), (565,397), (561,397), (561,395), (550,395), (550,376), ending at Route30 map34 (552,376). Each tile requires actual native admission and the exact settled endpoint. Stop new route input on natural Wild Ledyba acquisition and finish the admitted tile. Never teleport, edit party/save, force a spawn, change clock/RNG, or reset profile, motion or chain state.

Install the existing shared read-only native finalizer, resolver and spawn taps before boot. Retain the exact finalized Fly In targetBaseY, field-object constructor, START, object and full world identity. At the one finalized POOL target, use the shared loaded-terrain and authored-surface readers only at admission and exact logical terminal. Observe actor and engine state together at each authenticated completed-main-queue boundary with public semantic trace.

Bind only the current naturally spawned Wild Ledyba. Retain its actual off-screen field-object creation call and every coherent frame from elapsed zero or one through the 144-frame Fly In and exact logical terminal/control return. Controller replay must reject landing-tile creation, an invalid first render, changed subjects or POOL site, missing native provenance, missing target cells, and missing terminal meanings.

limits: This S3 scenario retains the own-site requirement and adds a separate loaded-metatile, authored-surface-exclusion and native terminal-height requirement. It does not clear population, later mobility, Ledyba chain, visual-quality, cadence or long-run requirements.

Coordinate equality is not surface proof. Require the exact loaded admission and terminal metatile for this Land/Surf encounter, no authored surface at its own target, and terminal physical Y equal to the native finalized ground height with zero shared height offset. A Fly In does not use the obsolete Hop height-refresh receipt. Unknown terrain/catalog or inferred height cannot prove land. Universal unmodeled geometry and other species/roles are outside this claim.

The profile must be the actual winning authored legacy POOL owner rule. Explicit modern destination overrides, forced or conditional layers, headbutt encounters and tree-top exceptions are outside this witness and fail its setup contract.
A native personality/shiny finalizer may change PID. Bind the actor to the final output PID while keeping species, form and level exact; do not require the earlier candidate PID to survive.

Require the actual native constructor at the off-screen origin, the authored 16-cardinal-tile Fly In (kind 9), the first coherent elapsed-zero or elapsed-one sample, all remaining samples through144, exact logical commit and control return. This reuses the shared MotionRecorder and proves the spawn prefix, not later chain actions.

The whole job is limited to 6000 completed game frames and 300 seconds. The final observation action is limited to 512 frames and 60 seconds, with 240 no-progress frames. At least 16 bound-subject observation frames are required; setup frames do not meet that floor.

Missing frames or native sequences, invalid identity/presentation, missing finalizer/spawn pairing, altered setup mode, timeout or incomplete landing fail. Keep original failure evidence; a setup failure is not proof of a changed destination.

Run only through the registered shared Workshop/owctl job. A pure checker result is not acceptance; the controller must independently replay the current ROM, save, source, recipe and retained observations. Stop only the private session owned by this job.
